title: FlapLab Daily — Officer Whiskers On Patrol
story: You are Officer Whiskers. You've already detained one suspect by sitting on him. Now the precinct's donut towers are blocking your patrol route — stay professional.
inspiration: Officer Whiskers meme (13–15 Oct 2026): a tuxedo cat calmly sitting on a detained suspect's back while police look on, captioned 'Officer Whiskers detains another suspect', spawning cat-cop edits — X Trending 'Officer Whiskers Cat Meme Captures Internet Attention' (x.com/i/trending/2110063321109942701).
